Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a report on the employment status of basic health plan and medical assistance recipients.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the employment status of basic health plan andmedical assistance recipients; adding a new section to chapter 70.47RCW; adding a new section to chapter 74.09 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.47 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The health care authority, in coordination with the department ofsocial and health services, shall by December 1st of each year reportto the legislature for each month of the preceding fiscal year thenumber of basic health plan enrollees who were employed, or who werethe spouse or dependent child of someone who was employed, and thetotal cost to the state for these enrollees. The information shall bereported in total, and by employer and industry type for any employeror industry type having more than thirty employees enrolled.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of social and health services, in coordination with p. 1 SSB 6759the health care authority, shall by December 1st of each year report tothe legislature for each month of the preceding fiscal year the numberof medical assistance recipients who were employed, or who were thespouse or dependent child of someone who was employed, and the totalcost to the state for these recipients. The information shall bereported in total, and by employer and industry type for any employeror industry type having more than thirty employees as recipients.
